question: Integrate RNA-Seq and WGS data to identify A-to-I RNA editing sites. Exclude sites that are present as germline variants in the WGS data. Report editing percentage and a confidence score for each candidate site.

expected_output.guidelines: Each editing site row must match the reference in genomic coordinates and nucleotide counts (A/C/G/T); editing_percentage must match within +/-0.1; confidence_score may vary based on scoring formula but must be a positive numeric value; variant_type label may differ (e.g. 'A->G', 'A_to_I') as long as it indicates A-to-I editing; column order and header labels may differ.
